# Mafiree

> > Mafiree provides expert database consulting, managed services, and cloud solutions for MongoDB, MySQL, and PostgreSQL across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud platforms.

Mafiree specializes in database architecture, optimization, migration, and high availability solutions tailored to industry-specific needs. The company offers comprehensive managed services including 24/7 support, cloud deployment, and DevOps integration for enterprise database infrastructure.

## Key Topics

- MongoDB Atlas
- MySQL Consulting
- PostgreSQL
- AWS RDS & Aurora
- Database Managed Services
- Cloud Database Solutions
- High Availability & Replication
- Database Migration
- MongoDB Solutions
- Azure & Google Cloud SQL
- Database Optimization
- Industry-Specific Solutions
- DevOps Integration
- Database Security
- Scalable Database Architecture
